item.ptxt: Initializing the learned values clears both the G sensor 0-point learning values and the CVT hydraulic pressure learning values, so when replacing the parts in the table below, perform AT/CVT learned value initialization and be sure to perform both G sensor 0-point learning and CVT hydraulic pressure learning.
After performing AT/CVT learned value initialization, be sure to perform G sensor 0-point learning first, and then CVT hydraulic pressure learning.

When replacing the skid control computer or the yaw rate sensor on vehicles with the Intelligent Parking Assist system, be sure to also perform G sensor 0 point writing for the Intelligent Parking Assist system.

step1.ptxt: A/T / CVT Learned Value Initialization, G Sensor 0-point Learning and CVT Hydraulic Pressure Learning

step3.ptxt: Turn the IG OFF, move the shift lever to the P position and apply the parking brake.
Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, select [Utility] from the TOP menu and select [Transmission] in the utility category.
Select [A/T/CVT Learned Value Initialization] on the screen to initialize the learned values.

item.ptxt: Be sure to place the vehicle on a level surface and perform 0 point learning.
Do not subject the vehicle to vibration while 0 point learning is in progress.
Do not start the engine, to avoid idling vibration.

step3.ptxt: Turn the IG ON (engine stopped) and wait for 2 seconds or more.
Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, select [Utility] from the TOP menu and select [Transmission] in the utility category.
Select [G Sensor 0 Point Learning Start] on the screen to perform G sensor 0 point learning. (*1)

item.ptxt: When [Complete] is displayed on the screen, G sensor 0 point learning is complete.
If [Error] is displayed on the screen and the check engine warning light comes on, there may be a malfunction in the G sensor circuit.

If the vehicle is subjected to vibration during 0 point learning, 0 point learning may be canceled. (If [Error] is displayed on the screen and the check engine warning light does not illuminate) In that case, perform the work in (*1) again.

step3.ptxt: Turn the IG OFF and wait for 30 seconds or more.
Turn the IG ON (engine stopped) and wait for 2 seconds or more.
Using SST (TaSCAN), follow the screen instructions to select [Work Support] on the TOP menu, then select [Transmission] in the work support category.
Start the engine and wait for 5 seconds or more.
Select [CVT Hydraulic Pressure Learning Start] on the screen to perform CVT hydraulic pressure learning.

item.ptxt: During CVT hydraulic pressure learning, the engine is in an idle-up state.
CVT hydraulic pressure learning is complete when [Complete] is displayed on the screen.
The CVT hydraulic pressure learned values are not initialized just by disconnecting the battery terminal.
